findings.identity: Original source head, torso and both holding hands move as one upper-body affine group.
findings.legs: Thigh/shin joint motion comes from fixed-length two-bone IK; shoes have independent pitch and declared sole targets. Knee/ankle pixels are continuously sampled from each original full-leg texture.
findings.walk: Near leg supports frames00-03; far leg supports04-07. Opposite contacts00/04 and alternating foot lift remain visible at fixed63px source scale.
findings.surface: No sliced shin/shoe gaps seen in reviewed continuous-texture contact sheets or63px playback. Folded inner joint skin uses explicit painter-order self-occlusion; no inverse-warp fold-zero claim.
findings.grip: All18 handGrip values exactly equal the same upperBody matrix applied to locked primary source C[251.5625,305.2].
findings.scale: Every frame retains the same512 logical source canvas, foot[256,435.2], pivot[.5,.85] and source-group scale.

visualReview.limitation: Hip centers are inferred under the source hand/pelvis occlusion; this remains a locally rigged candidate awaiting main-session animation review.

limitations: Only front_right produced; no front rotation substituted for back_right.

Hip joints are inferred under hand/pelvis occlusion; small sampled material caps close hidden hip connections. Original full-leg texture is continuously skinned across knee/ankle, not internally cut/pasted.
No weapon, VFX, ground shadow or source-canvas recentering is baked.
